summary: Household in Delaware: two adults and one child, about $100k household earnings. Most income-tested programmes are out at this income: SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, SSI, WIC, CHIP, free/reduced school meals, and EITC. Recommend the Child Tax Credit (refundable part), which applies if the child is under 17 and the family has earned income; the caseworker should confirm the child's age. ACA premium tax credit may apply if no one has job-based health insurance offered, since the household income is below the 400% federal poverty line cliff; this was not confirmed because the household did not know whether job coverage was available, so the caseworker should check that before recommending it. Hand off to a caseworker to verify the child's age, job-based health coverage, and exact income.
